contract_answer.question: What is the valid CPMLP baseline for ZN-coin split 2021 under the v6 locked workflow?
contract_answer.conclusion: The run is complete, finite, protocol-compliant, reproducible, and therefore interpretable, but it is a blocked and discarded baseline rather than a promotable reference: epoch 1 is the unique minimum-MAPE checkpoint (MAPE 0.434598, Acc@15 0.100), and every later epoch is outside the 0.005 checkpoint tolerance. Predictions collapse near 140 cycles and the late head-to-intra_mlp.1 gradient ratio is 5081.9x, so the gradient gate fails. In plain language, this CPMLP mostly learned one short-life answer instead of distinguishing cells. Its one-split MAPE is numerically lower than the BatteryLife Zn-ion CPMLP three-split result (0.558 +/- 0.034), but its Acc@15 is much lower (0.100 versus 0.297 +/- 0.084); the loss/checkpoint workflow differs and one split cannot establish an improvement.

main_symptom: Selected-checkpoint predictions are almost constant (mean 140.419, population SD 1.539, range 136.979-142.972) while targets have mean 413.900 and SD 407.450, yielding MAPE 0.434598, Acc@15 0.100, correlation -0.0011, and mean signed relative error -0.3358. Validation never improves after epoch 1 despite eight more complete 46-step epochs at lr 5e-4; later MAPE values are 0.4425-0.4841 except epoch 9 at 0.4470, all above the epoch-1 eligibility ceiling of 0.439598.

contradicting_evidence: diagnostics.json.summary.activation_health reports healthy, finite activations for every instrumented block.
diagnostics.json.summary.layer_health reports nonzero gradients and updates rather than disconnected blocks.
missing_evidence: Equivalent selected-checkpoint prediction distributions for splits 42 and 2024.
A matched repaired run showing whether restoring gradient balance restores cell-dependent spread.

contradicting_evidence: No layer is disconnected, frozen, non-finite, activation-collapsed, or individually classified UNHEALTHY.
Mean training loss decreases from 0.07147 at epoch 1 to 0.05549 at epoch 9.
causes.interpretation: At the later diagnostic snapshot the head gradient/parameter ratio is 0.1508 while intra_mlp.1 is 2.967e-5, a 5081.9x imbalance over the 1000x warning threshold. With only 46 optimizer steps per epoch at the paper lr 5e-4, the model reaches its best validation result after the first 46 steps; continued training lowers train loss but never beats epoch 1, consistent with rapid attraction to a short-life constant solution. This warning is not proof that the architecture is disconnected, but program.md makes it a failed gradient gate that blocks promotion and requires an explanation or matched repair.
missing_evidence: A true end-of-run gradient snapshot after step 414; the saved later snapshot is step 185.
A matched repair that changes only gradient flow or its diagnostic sampling while preserving the paper baseline recipe where possible.

contradicting_evidence: Phase 1 locks Relative Huber, so this run cannot isolate loss choice from representation and optimization.
The local run uses the paper architecture and optimizer hyperparameters but not the paper MSE objective, making the paper aggregate contextual rather than a matched control.
causes.interpretation: Fifteen of 20 cells are below 500 cycles, and Relative Huber directly weights relative error. A prediction near 140 cycles gives low error on a few short-life cells while producing MAPE 0.8327 for the two 500-1000-cycle cells and 0.8843 for the three >1000-cycle cells. This may explain why local MAPE looks better than the paper mean while Acc@15 is worse, but Phase 1 evidence cannot identify it as the primary cause.
missing_evidence: A matched MSE reproduction is unavailable and outside the locked Phase-1 loss contract.
Three-split local aggregate needed for an honest comparison with the paper's mean +/- standard deviation.

layers.name: intra_embed
layers.role: Embed each cycle curve before intra-cycle processing.
layers.reason: Finite gradients, nonzero updates, and healthy activations; no block-local failure is measured.

layers.name: intra_mlp.1
layers.role: Representative early intra-cycle MLP block and the smallest late gradient-scale endpoint.
layers.reason: It is connected and updating, but its late gradient/parameter ratio is 5081.9x below the head, exceeding the blocking 1000x imbalance threshold; first obtain a true late snapshot and then use the smallest matched gradient-flow repair if confirmed.

layers.name: inter_flatten
layers.role: Combine masked cycle representations for inter-cycle prediction.
layers.reason: It has finite nonzero gradients and updates. Padding sensitivity is documented, but cached masked slots are exactly zero, so no future-cycle leakage is measured.

layers.name: inter_mlp.8
layers.role: Final inter-cycle MLP block before the regression head.
layers.reason: Healthy finite gradient, update, and activation diagnostics do not justify replacement from this run alone.

layers.name: head
layers.role: Map the learned representation to standardized EOL.
layers.reason: The head is healthy and connected; its much larger gradient scale is evidence of an upstream balance problem, not evidence that the head itself should be removed.

screen_floor.reason: ZN-E000 is a full_candidate baseline with no matched reference, so the screening hard floor is not applicable.

next_action.summary: Retain ZN-E000 as the valid but non-promotable split-2021 paper-reference run, and run ZN-E001 and ZN-E002 on splits 42 and 2024 with the identical accepted CPMLP recipe to complete the local three-split mean +/- SD. Do not repair the baseline; use the measured prediction collapse and 5081.9x gradient imbalance to motivate a separately proposed Phase-1 architecture candidate under locked Relative Huber 0.15.
